capabilities: Render a scaled-down whole-note minimap at the edge of the editor pane
Jump to a position by clicking or dragging the minimap or scrolling over it
Mirror the note's modes, folds, properties, code highlighting and theme
Toggle the minimap per note or per device and adjust scale, opacity and offsets
extras: The manifest carries a notice that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README is unusually deep on internal mechanics (anchor-based scroll mapping, partial redraws, margin-based layout) and explains limits such as folds not mirrored in rendered modes and narrow-pane behavior.
problem: Long notes are hard to navigate, and minimap approaches that clone the editor's DOM only capture the on-screen portion because Obsidian virtualizes long notes.
summary: Code-editor-style minimap for Markdown notes that renders the whole note independently of the editor's virtualization and lets you navigate it by click, drag or wheel.
